cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You don't think they let me win the race, do you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Because they couldn't maintain my pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then acknowledge my superior knot preparation.
